messages:
Aisha: quick preflight check for release train — cut candidate built at 09:10 UTC. Cherries queued: #482 (hotfix kv-cache), #487 (retry backoff). CI: unit + e2e green, flaky quant tests failing 2/5 runs.
Tom: noted. which quant tests are flaky? can we gate cherry-picks?
Aisha: it's the quant-matrix overflow test in eng-ml/regressions, failing during INT8 runs. repro script attached in PR.
Priya: @Aisha can you link the PRs? also, do we have a canary window today?
Aisha: PRs: https://git.internal/pr/482 , https://git.internal/pr/487. Canary window 14:00-15:00 UTC. Recommend hold #487 until we confirm retry fix doesn't regress latency. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ReleaseBot: deploy pipeline started for candidate 2025.06.rc9 — build id cbf7d. Canary targets: infra-stage-1, infra-stage-2.
Derek: CI flakiness looks like a timeout not correctness. I can add a longer timeout and re-run the quant-suite. Will re-run now.
Tom: if Derek's re-run is green, can we merge #482 and schedule #487 post-canary? avoids blocking rollback path.
Aisha: yes. plan: merge #482 once green, hold #487 until post-canary signoff. I'll open a ticket to track.
Lee: heads up — release-notes draft updated with kv-cache fix and rollback instructions. Pinging docs for a quick review. :memo:
Derek: re-run passes 3/3 now after timeout bump. pushing a tiny patch to the test harness, will link.
Aisha: awesome, thanks. merging #482 in 5.
Tom: I'll watch canary metrics (latency, error-rate) and call it at 14:30 if stable. ping me if anything spikes.
Aisha: cool. blockers: none else. follow-ups: post-canary signoff, merge #487 or revert plan.
Priya: thanks — updating the release board. :white_check_mark:
